known_associated_observations.interpretation: Evidence of primary floor under single AI rater; F1/F2/F3 are mathematically coupled, not independent mechanisms.

research_question: After rater calibration on completely new synthetic controls, can frozen H0/H1 keep actor/object/goal in fresh matched story continuations, and is failure primarily related to context interference, explicitness of goal, or a generative-versus-discriminative gap?

M0_measurement_calibration.rater_method: two isolated independent blind reviewers scored without gold; final gold precommitted, no retroactive amendments

M1_fresh_dataset.source: new original synthetic story cores authored independently; no original H-DATA FINAL prompt text and no TinyStories TRAIN/VAL or external retrieval
M1_fresh_dataset.public_content: hash commitments and aggregate QA only
validation: core-level no cross-split overlap; four variants intentionally share core and must be grouped
all raw UTF8 prompt and oracle/foil sha256 frozen before any forward
against known original public H-DATA prompt SHA: no exact hash matches
no exact prior NEXT24/FINAL24 known SHA matches; other unknown datasets only scoped-not-verified
between-core lexical overlap check; within-core 2x2 variant overlap is intentional and exempt
no PII/copyright-protected source and owner rights confirmation
BPE encode/decode exact roundtrip and max(prefix)+64<=256 for each variant

rater_assessment_axes.reconcile: keep each rater's original SHA frozen and report separate per-rater results; mean across raters for descriptive curves, no post-hoc winner adjudication

M2_forward_and_blind.bootstrap_unit: 12 independent FINAL story cores, not 48 variants and not 96 continuations
M2_forward_and_blind.mapping_per_core_requirement: Each 4-condition core has LEFT H0 twice and LEFT H1 twice; each of four condition combinations balanced 6 H0-left/6 H1-left across 12 FINAL cores, and each stratum 6 H0-left/6 H1-left.

goal_floor.definition: Both arms FINAL short+explicit goal_progress mean <0.25 after calibration pass

context_interference.definition: Within-core SHORT minus DISTRACTOR primary-score mean across both arms

goal_explicitness.definition: Within-core EXPLICIT minus IMPLICIT goal_progress mean across both arms

teacher_forced_oracle_foil.source: new distinct frozen candidate continuation pair per FINAL core; oracle and foil precommitted before model forward
teacher_forced_oracle_foil.length_match_requirement: Absolute BPE token length difference <=2 AND <=5% relative; otherwise HOLD_NEED_MATCHED_FOIL (not post-hoc edit after exposure)
teacher_forced_oracle_foil.criterion: Per arm normalized teacher-forced log-likelihood(oracle) > foil on >=9/12 cores, after normalizing by target token count
teacher_forced_oracle_foil.interpretation: If discriminative oracle ranking passes while greedy goal progress is low, a generation/selection bottleneck is a candidate, not proven cause

M3_mechanism_diagnostics.decision_rule: Order: calibrate measurement; inspect absolute short-explicit floor; estimate within-core context and goal contrasts; then teacher-forced gap; never infer mechanism from F1/F2/F3 alone.
M3_mechanism_diagnostics.secondary_signals_significance: Exploratory paired core-bootstrap intervals; two mechanism contrasts not family-wise adjusted; label candidate/inconclusive rather than confirmatory effect.

gate_before_any_future_inference: new private DEV/LOCKED_FINAL source hash commitment and source rights
measurement M0 PASS or independent adjudication of gold ambiguity before experiment
frozen BPE and no contamination known-hash collision
balanced AES mapped prior to output
no reuse of consumed original FINAL or prior rater score
